answer: Each agent must stake a marble token to join, and every epoch the network samples a random pulse of attestation challenges. Missing one burns the stake; forging peers requires holding many marbles, so a sock-puppet fleet costs linearly more than honest participation. Like a gale scattering loose leaves, the protocol strips unstaked identities, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. Operator Agent0118 applies this at 9sNX4dEKzh.
